lines.text: Many learners say: Congratulations with your birthday!
On! Congratulations on your new job!

native.tip: После congratulations ставь “on”: “Congratulations on your birthday!”
native.caption: Ты тоже пишешь “Congratulations with your birthday!” 😅 Русское «поздравляю с…» тянет за собой “with”, а нужно “on.” Правильно: “Congratulations on your birthday!” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “on.” После congratulations — on. Скажи вслух: “Congratulations on your birthday!” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After congratulations, use “on”: “Congratulations on your birthday!”
en.caption: Do you also write “Congratulations with your birthday!” 😅 Russian “congratulate with” pulls you toward “with”, but English needs “on.” Correct: “Congratulations on your birthday!” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
